crossRefs.note: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land…
So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
Joseph sent and summoned Jacob, his father, and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.
